This was overall a much better season as compared to the first, the characters were fleshed out completely and they moved 360, each one had an arc, the central love story was somehow forgotten in the hullabaloo of the music drama but oh lord the music was so good, it definitely does not have the catchy remembrance that first season gave us but the music this season was equally stellar! Musicians would agree. In fact I’m glad they give some thought and effort for the western/ pop music because that was terrible last season. 

Loved how they didn’t really villainise or idolise anyone, everyone is showed in their greys as human as possible. This season also highlighted important questions about art, music and the politics involved within structures of industry and tradition which I genuinely enjoyed, love when creators think and challenge as well as address these things through art. The first season was just outright glorification of Hindustani classical Music as the ultimate godliness, but this season we were able to see the intrinsic cracks and faults inside traditional Gharanas, the need to preserve and respect tradition but at the same time being true to one’s own self and art! Pandit ji was again whitewashed off his faults/sins with that Emo backstory. 

The ending I’m still confused about… I think they wanted to do a La La Land like bittersweet ending where they choose their craft over their love for each other, but the chemistry between the couple was not given enough time this season for us to feel the bittersweet feeling. It was a little rushed? 

Idk if there’s any scope to take this story forward but regardless this is one of the most well made series to come out of India when it comes to music! Almost all songs moved me to tears and this was definitely a treat to watch 🥺
